instructions:
Map file paths to Google Drive file IDs. Follow these steps:
1. Upload your audio files to a Google Drive folder
2. Right-click each file and get the shareable link
3. Extract the file ID from the link (the long alphanumeric string)
4. Add the mapping below in format: 'path/to/file.mp3': 'FILE_ID'

mappings._comment: Example format - replace with your actual Google Drive file IDs

driveFolder.description: Shared Google Drive folder containing all large audio files

howToGetFileId.step1: Right-click the file in Google Drive > Share
howToGetFileId.step4: Paste the FILE_ID in the mappings above
